mapper.select: SELECT dhp.id, dhp.device_id AS deviceId, d.code AS deviceCode, d.name AS deviceName, dhp.bind_time AS bindTime, dhp.install_longitude AS installLongitude, dhp.install_latitude AS installLatitude, d.status AS deviceStatus, dos.status AS onlineStatus, d.icon AS icon, d.icon_path AS iconPath FROM device_hazard_point dhp INNER JOIN device d ON dhp.device_id = d.id AND d.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN device_online_status dos ON dos.device_id = d.id WHERE dhp.hazard_point_id = #{hazardPointId} ORDER BY dhp.bind_time DESC

SELECT d.id, CONCAT(d.code, ' - ', d.name) AS label, d.status, d.icon AS icon, d.icon_path AS iconPath, dos.status AS onlineStatus, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_hazard_point dhp2 WHERE dhp2.device_id = d.id ) AS bindCount FROM device d LEFT JOIN device_online_status dos ON dos.device_id = d.id WHERE d.del_flag = 0 AND d.id NOT IN (SELECT device_id FROM device_hazard_point ) AND ( #{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_sensor ds WHERE ds.device_id = d.id AND ds.del_flag = 0 AND ds.sensor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY d.id DESC

INSERT INTO device_hazard_point (device_id, hazard_point_id, install_longitude, install_latitude, bind_time, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.deviceId}, #{item.hazardPointId}, #{item.installLongitude}, #{item.installLatitude}, SYSDATE(), #{item.createBy}, SYSDATE())

INSERT INTO device_hazard_point (device_id, hazard_point_id, install_longitude, install_latitude, bind_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.deviceId}, #{item.hazardPointId}, #{item.installLongitude}, #{item.installLatitude}, SYSDATE(), #{item.createBy}, SYSDATE(), #{item.createBy}, SYSDATE())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE install_longitude = VALUES(install_longitude), install_latitude = VALUES(install_latitude), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = SYSDATE()
